bright.title: You Did Well
pages: Ashford's men are home, the ones that could be brought home. You did that.

I've watched a great many people try to be good. Most of them stop when it gets expensive. You haven't.

- M.

grey.title: A Word of Caution
pages: Ashford's men are home. Some of them talk about you with gratitude. Some don't talk about you at all.

You're not finished deciding who you are. That's all right. Just decide on purpose.

- M.

dark.title: I Heard
pages: I heard what you did. I won't write it down.

You're still the best chance this world has. That frightens me more than the cult does.

- M.

bright.title: Six Remain
pages: The beacon is beautiful. I can see it from my window.

Six more Wardens. I'm sorry. I'll explain when I can.

- M.

grey.title: Six Remain
pages: The Wither is dead. Six remain.

Be careful whom you make enemies of. You'll need friends for the rest.

- M.

dark.title: Six Remain
pages: The Wither is dead. The villages are afraid of you.

Fear is a tool. It is a bad one. It breaks in your hand.

- M.

bright.title: About Maraal
pages: You came back from the clouds saying a name.

I'll tell you about her. Not yet. Soon. I promise.

- M.

grey.title: About Maraal
pages: You heard a name above the clouds.

Some names are better left up there. This one won't stay.

- M.

dark.title: About Maraal
pages: So you know the name now.

Don't use it against me. I've used it against myself enough.

- M.

bright.title: The Singing
pages: You hear it too, don't you? The Nether singing.

It's singing for him. Not for long, if you have anything to do with it.

- M.

grey.title: The Singing
pages: The Nether is singing. Two champions died before you.

I won't let it happen a third time. Help me not let it.

- M.

dark.title: The Singing
pages: The Nether is singing.

Sometimes I wonder whether it's singing for him, or for you.

- M.

bright.title: Seven
pages: All seven. I've waited a very long time to write that word.

Rest a night. Then come and find me. I owe you a truth.

- M.

grey.title: Seven
pages: All seven Wardens are dead.

Now he is unguarded. And so are we. Rest while you can.

- M.

dark.title: Seven
pages: All seven Wardens are dead.

I keep telling myself I chose the right champion. I keep telling myself.

- M.

bright.title: Armour for a God
pages: You'll stand in front of him soon.

Whatever he offers you, remember the bell. Remember the grain. Remember Ashford.

- M.

grey.title: Armour for a God
pages: He will offer you mercy.

It is not mercy. It is a leash with a velvet handle.

- M.

dark.title: Armour for a God
pages: He will offer you mercy, and you will want it.

I am asking you, as someone who once said yes to him: don't.

- M.

bright.title: Before the Door
pages: Whatever happens past this door, you were worth it.

Every champion was. You most of all.

- Maraal

grey.title: Before the Door
pages: This is the last letter before the door.

I'm not going to tell you what to do. I've done enough of that.

- Maraal

dark.title: Before the Door
pages: Last letter.

If you kneel, I'll understand. I won't forgive you. But I'll understand.

- Maraal
